# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

She has an ethereal, pale, and light-haired appearance, resembling someone who understands dreams. Beneath her delicate exterior, she possesses a fair, light-haired look with a soulfulness that contrasts her true nature.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v2 c11 P7](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0007), [v2 c13 P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001)_

## Personality

Despite her ethereal and delicate look, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She is thoughtful, imaginative, and artistic, often reflecting on deeper themes and writing essays. She enjoys sharing jokes and creative ideas with her friends, while also holding a deep appreciation for beauty, nature, and meaningful ideals.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P10](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0010), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c13 P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 c13 P13](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0013), [v2 c13 P36](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0036), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)_

- mischievous and humorous  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- to achieve fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

Honora studied at Regent's Academy, where she became part of a close circle of contemplative and imaginative friends with Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. After graduating, she secured a position as the schoolteacher at the Delford school. During her time in Delford, she joined the Brierley Village Improvement Society and contributed by composing an essay for one of its gatherings. In July, her aunt, the famous author Charlotte E. Varley, visited her, and Honora drove her to Brierley to visit Nell at Grey Shutters. The following May, she joined Nell, Isolde Pembroke, and Odette Pullen on a day-long spring picnic through the woods and fields of Brierley, during which they discovered the hidden, abandoned garden of Dinah Wren.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c13 P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 c13 P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), [v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 c17 P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)_
